page.title: Renegades
page.t: Upon inspection of the ship wreckage you find a damaged data recorder and are able to extract this fragment from the message queue:
Upon inspection of the ship wreckage you find a communications pod with a partial message still in the buffer: \n \n

What is this broken hull that lies before you? A renegade ship has finally been identified and destroyed. You carefully search the wreckage and find the remains of the space recorder. It is scarred and pitted but the micro electron memory unit is still intact. Blood is spattered everywhere, but you shrug it off. After all, it wasn`t you who started this fight, but you are sure going to end it.

Through careful analysis and reconstruction, and judicious use of a case of confiscated Albion Ale, you are able to decode data fragment that leads you to believe something important has been staged in [green]%s[/green]. \nSomewhere in this system lies an old shipwreck being used as an "entropic gateway segmentation challenger"; whatever that means. It appears that somehow the old shipwreck and your data scanner are related and linked to some sort of special sequence they call "Renegade Gate Reintegration". The computer A.I. can`t make heads or tails of the statement. I guess we`ll just have to find out what it means ourselves.
Hey %s, I forgot to give you part %s of the home system code. It`s %s. Memorize it and erase it from your buffers.

%s: Your authorization has been granted for system entry. Please use entry code %s. This information is need to know only and should be stored only in an approved Terracorp encrypted memory module. Do not fail us.
This is Dispatch. The entry code has been set per data security guidelines and is now %s. Please memorize and purge this information from your computer log and communications buffer. Have a nice day.
What`s up, %s? Yea, I was just back at that renegade base for repairs and a bath. The docking bay seemed pretty busy. I saw at least %s class %s ships sitting there, so they seem ready for anything.
Hey, %s, how are things?\n\nI was hunting over in %s and noticed a strange ship hanging out. Thought he may be one of those renegades so I gave him a wide berth. Watch your six, buddy.
No one likes the renegades. We offer them bribes to keep them off our backs.
You did not get this from me, but rumor has it that an %s named %s hired the renegades to attack the Independents. No one knows why the renegades were hired.
You did not get this from me, but rumor has it that a %s named %s hired the renegades to attack the Independents. No one knows why the renegades were hired.\n
I heard rumors that a fellow pirate named %s is secretly funding the renegades. Do not snitch him out or our heads are next.

[green]The Renegade threat has finally ended![/green]

As you look through the rubble, you spot quite a few wares that were ejected into space and greedily start gathering them. 

You also spot a slight glint in one of the piles of wreckage and notice some engineering specifications that identify a number of improvements you could make to your shipbuilding capabilities. Your engineers are astounded and quickly make plans for changes. 

[green]Renegades Plot Reward: Outpost ship specialization increased by 10%[/green].

A few straggler renegades may still be out there somewhere, but they are not much of a threat to you. Job Well Done!

[yellow]The Renegades hidden jump gate has been revealed.[/yellow] You will have to deal decisively with what lies beyond. Unfortunately for you, the Renegade leaders will now have to deal with you decisively! Expect trouble at your front door. Deal with them before they deal with you.

[green]You have mastered terraforming![/green]

One of your terraforming teams reports back to you. They have found a strange object on one of your planets.

They describe what they`ve found, and you identify the object as an old piece of Terran technology used long ago for terraforming projects. Your scientists run a few benchmark tests, and they confirm that the object is far more advanced than any terraforming equipment you`ve used, advanced enough to improve your terraforming efforts. You give them approval to reverse engineer the object and incorporate its features into your terraformer drones.

[green]Your empire can now support 1 additional terraforming project per %s planets in your empire.[/green]
